function printStudent() { printMode = 'student'; renderPreview(); setTimeout(function() { if (window.ExamPrintNative && window.ExamPrintNative.print) { window.ExamPrintNative.print('student'); } else { window.print(); } }, 80); } function printTeacher() { printMode = 'teacher'; renderPreview(); setTimeout(function() { if (window.ExamPrintNative && window.ExamPrintNative.print) { window.ExamPrintNative.print('teacher'); } else { window.print(); } }, 80); } window.addEventListener('afterprint', () => { printMode = 'student'; renderPreview(); }); window.setExamData = function(data) { if (!data) return; if (typeof data === "string") { try { data = JSON.parse(data); } catch(e) { console.error("setExamData parse error", e); return; } } if (typeof data === "string") { try { data = JSON.parse(data); } catch(e) { console.error("setExamData parse error", e); return; } } if (data.template) { var tEl = document.getElementById("f_headerTemplate"); if (tEl) { tEl.value = data.template; } } if (data.fields) { Object.keys(data.fields).forEach(function(k) { var el = document.getElementById(k); if (el) { if (el.type === "checkbox") el.checked = !!data.fields[k]; else el.value = data.fields[k]; } }); } if (Array.isArray(data.questions)) { questions = data.questions.map(function(q, i) { if (!q.id) q.id = i + 1; return q; }); qIdCounter = questions.length; } updateHeaderSettingsVisibility(); renderAll(); };
